blurb: Built on the foundations of two legendary early 20th-century venues, the original Lyric and Apollo Theatres, the Lyric Theatre blends historic grandeur with modern elegance. Now showing Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, this stunning Broadway venue welcomes guests into a world of architectural beauty and theatrical excellence.
